entries.title: Protect pending review copies when window access changes
entries.description: ReviewOps stops a pending copy if its original window's QA access changes, the window closes, or its data is restored before saving. Releasing QA does not revive the old request; start a new copy when access is available again. Ordinary activity history and QA work in other windows remain compatible.

entries.title: Show copy failures inside the copy dialog
entries.description: After a review copy is refused, the dialog shows the actual reason in the current interface language and re-enables Cancel. Successful copies continue to refresh the project.

entries.title: Reject attachment selections from outdated requests
entries.description: If QA disconnects or the selected review is restored, replaced, or now belongs to another project, ReviewOps rejects the pending attachment save. Existing files stay intact, and normal history and next-service changes continue.

entries.title: Avoid extra refreshes when opening review versions
entries.description: Opening a review's version list no longer triggers extra app refreshes. Saved versions and target changes still refresh the interface.

entries.title: Protect review versions from outdated saves
entries.description: If a review or its selected attachments change while files are being read, the save stops and asks you to recheck the copies. Newer saved records are preserved.
